description_en: Associates multiple elastic IP addresses (EIPs) with a cloud service instance in the same region in a batch
description_zh: 调用AssociateEipAddressBatch接口批量将弹性公网IP（Elastic IP Address，简称EIP）绑定到同地域的云产品实例上
kebab_example: aliyun vpc associate-eip-address-batch --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --binded-instance-id ngw-hp3akk9irtd69jad0000 --binded-instance-type Nat --biz-mode MULTI_BINDED --instance-ids eip-2zeerraiwb7ujsxdc0000 --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-0016e04115b --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociateEipAddressBatch

parameters.description_en:
The region ID of the EIPs to associate with the cloud service instance.

You can call [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) to query the region ID.
parameters.description_zh:
要绑定云产品实例的EIP所在的地域ID。
您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the EIPs to associate with the cloud service instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要绑定云产品实例的EIP所在的地域ID。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the cloud service instance to attach the EIPs to.

You can specify the instance ID of an Internet NAT gateway instance or a secondary network interface controller (NIC) instance.
parameters.description_zh:
要绑定EIP的云产品实例ID。

支持输入NAT网关实例ID、辅助弹性网卡实例ID。
parameters.help_en:

parameters.description_en:
The type of the instance to attach the EIPs to. Valid values:
- **Nat**: Internet NAT gateway.
- **NetworkInterface**: secondary network interface controller (NIC).
parameters.description_zh:
要绑定EIP的实例的类型，取值：
- **Nat**：NAT网关。
- **NetworkInterface**：辅助弹性网卡。

parameters.description_en:
The association mode. Set the value to **MULTI_BINDED**, which specifies the multi-EIP-to-ENI mode.

This parameter is required only when **InstanceType** is set to **NetworkInterface**.
parameters.description_zh:
绑定模式，仅取值为**MULTI_BINDED**，表示多EIP网卡可见模式。

仅**InstanceType**配置为**NetworkInterface**时，才需要配置该参数。

parameters.description_en:
The list of EIPs to associate with the cloud service instance.

You must specify at least 1 EIP and can specify up to 50 EIPs.

需要与云产品实例绑定的EIP列表。

需至少输入1个EIP，最多支持输入50个EIP。

parameters.description_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request.
parameters.description_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
